scope: Local UI usability cleanup after report note-placement and appendix fidelity work
changes: Document library exposes download, version history and a labelled More row; secondary operations and sharing retain existing APIs and authorization.
Common navigation uses consistent names, removes duplicate back navigation and renames the saved-document template library to 양식 보관함.
Report creation distinguishes content structure from document appearance, keeps the creation action visible below the independently scrolling input area and moves optional help into disclosures.
Report review promotes the next action, identifies summaries excluded from the final document and distinguishes the generated original from subsequent editor changes.

Standard designer consolidates preview actions, shows reference-only information when viewing the original and accurately describes new-standard defaults; loading a registered standard no longer marks it dirty.
Saved-template library removes the duplicate reference-standard card and inaccurate automatic-format claims while preserving registration, copy and metadata workflows.
AI rewriting is the primary editor action; optional separately configured model features require an explicit successful connection check.
Writing-context snapshots and review memos are labelled as app storage rather than an AI request; legacy data and detailed receipts remain accessible.
Completed rewrite history is collapsed while latest, running, cancellable, pending and unsaved applications remain directly accessible.
Unsent memo text participates in the existing leave/close guard; switching editor tools preserves mounted inputs. Unused legacy Templates modal removed.

validation.frontend_build: passed; production frontend build using the existing verified diagnostic rhwp bundle
validation.run_interpretation: Counts overlap. Initial failures were obsolete selectors, unscoped duplicate labels and outdated sidebar/reference-view assumptions. These were corrected without weakening save, permission or document-integrity assertions. Runs C and D resolve remaining failures and verify the final always-visible report action. No unresolved failures in the selected scenarios.
coverage: Document copy and lost-response idempotency, source preservation
Actual rhwp editing, save, download, reopen, mock AI approval and undo
Writing-context propagation and lost-response recovery preserving later input
Report content review, feedback revision, frozen retry, formatting, save and reopen
Standard preview freshness, invalid-setting handling, all three presets and reference immutability
Saved-template registration, pinned preview, favorites, metadata and lost-response copy recovery
Template pagination, revoked-source access and navigation without unintended document/model creation
Authenticated sharing, revocation and external proposal approval/stale-selection fences
Single editor panel, input preservation across tools and memo-only unsaved close guard
Authenticated block/TOC operations preserve pending user edits on access revocation
Expanded/icon/hidden sidebar persistence and responsive layouts; report action visible at 1366px and 400px
